speakers.speaker: amol-pardeshi
speakers.bio:
Amol Pardeshi is a Senior Android Engineer working at Gojek as a part of its Mobile Platform Team. Gojek is the largest super app in South East Asia boasting 100M+ users. Amol has over 6+ years of experience in Android development and for the past three years, he has been focused specifically on Android Performance Engineering.
His contributions include developing a custom ANR SDK from scratch for Gojek based on AppExitInfo, watchdog, and native SIGQUIT signal handling with proactive regression alerts. This along with other performance improvements including optimization of Dagger graphs, fixing of background processes, and implementation of AI-driven code guardrails led to a reduction of Gojek’s user perceived ANR rate by 80%. His areas of expertise include crash rate control, memory leaks avoidance, app size minimization, and app startup optimization with large multi-module Kotlin codebase.
Amol has spoken at droidcon India 2025 on Gojek's ANR reduction path and is an organizer in Bangalore Android community (BLRDroid).

Curated ANR and Leak patterns to avoid - https://mintlify.wiki/AmolPardeshi99/android-performance-skills
Agentic skills to write ANRs and Leaks free code - 
https://www.skills.sh/amolpardeshi99/android-performance-skills/android-performance-anr-and-jank-prevention
https://www.skills.sh/amolpardeshi99/android-performance-skills/android-performance-memory-leak-prevention
ANRLab – ANR Tooling: https://github.com/AmolPardeshi99/ANRLab/

speakers.speaker: amrit-sanjeev
speakers.bio: Amrit Sanjeev is a Staff Developer Advocate at Google India and is a lead in the Android Developer Relations team. speakers.speaker: anand-gaur
speakers.bio:
Anand Gaur is a Mobile Tech Lead at Tata Consultancy Services with 9+ years of experience building mobile applications across Android, iOS, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), and React Native. His recent work focuses on integrating AI into mobile applications, developing AI-powered features, and helping developers adopt modern AI technologies in production.

He is an active contributor to the developer community, having authored 200+ technical articles on Medium with 5.7K+ followers. Anand regularly mentors developers, conducts mock interviews, provides career guidance, and speaks at community events and conferences.

Anand is ranked among the top 0.1% of mentors globally on Topmate and received the Best Software IT Service Award 2025 for his contributions to the technology community.

He also leads a developer community of 3,300+ members focused on Mobile and AI, where he shares learning resources, job opportunities, and industry insights. Additionally, he is the author of six interview preparation and technical books covering Android, iOS, Flutter, React Native, Mobile System Design, and AI for Mobile Developers.

speakers.speaker: arun-sharma
speakers.bio: Arun Sharma leads the Instamart Apps team at Swiggy, focusing on platform performance and developer tooling for consumer-facing apps at scale. He has built tools and systems—including Swiggy Perf Kit, Perfetto trace analysis, JankStats, and Macrobenchmarking—that make Android apps faster, more reliable, and easier to debug across app shells and device classes. He is passionate about practical engineering, strong developer workflows, and building a lasting performance culture.

speakers.speaker: arun-kr-aditya
speakers.bio: I'm an Android Framework & Platform Engineer with 5.6 years of experience, currently at Mercedes-Benz Research & Development India — the largest R&D centre for the Mercedes-Benz Group AG outside Germany. I work on the infotainment platform and productivity apps (calendar, meetings, email) with deep expertise in AOSP, AIDL, Binder IPC, HAL, and system service development. On the side, I build independent hardware-to-UI projects on Raspberry Pi 5 and share everything I learn through technical articles on Medium (1M+ reads) and my YouTube channel Silicon to System. I have 18k+ followers on LinkedIn and believe in learning in public.

speakers.speaker: arvind-kumar-vartiya
speakers.bio:
I’m an Computer Scientist (AI Engineer) focused on building practical AI systems and intelligent agents. An IIT Kanpur alumnus, I work across Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, voice AI, and agentic AI.

I build AI-powered voice and WhatsApp agents, multi-agent systems, and automation solutions, with hands-on experience integrating LLMs, STT/TTS, LangGraph, MCP, and cloud AI platforms. I’m particularly interested in building reliable, production-ready AI systems that can interact naturally with users and take real-world actions.
